title: (RHBA-2021:3260) Red Hat Integration Operator 1.0.6
portal_summary: Release of the Red Hat Integration Operator version 1.0.6.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|4.7|x86_64
portal_solution: Can be installed from the OperatorHub in 4.6+ or Red Hat Marketplace.
portal_description:
The respin of the Integration Operator v1.0.5 was built with latest code from master, which is incorrect. it should be built with the code from the 1.0 branch.
This 1.0.6 version incorporates the correct code.
